The number of tankers attacked in the Strait of Hormuz on September 29 has risen
description:
The number of tankers attacked in the Strait of Hormuz on September 29 has risen to three, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported. 

All the three tankers were struck by unknown projectiles, the UKMTO said. In one instance, the vessel's port side was hit. One of the tankers was entering the strait when it was attacked.

There are currently no reports of casualties in any of the incidents. The names of the vessels and their ports of registry were not reported.

title: Joint US-Japanese military exercises Keen Sword will take place from October 19
description:

On the Japanese side, about 45,000 soldiers and officers as well as about 40 warships and 250 aircraft will be involved, it said. The size and composition of the US contingent was not disclosed.

description:

Starship уперше вийшов на орбіту під час 14-го тестового польоту SpaceX. 

Це перша орбітальна місія ракети: попередні 13 польотів були суборбітальними. Цього разу Starship має провести в космосі близько 10 годин і здійснити до шести обертів навколо Землі.

Під час польоту один із шести двигунів відмовив, але SpaceX продовжила місію. Також Starship уперше вивів на орбіту 26 супутників Starlink V3 — це перше реальне розгортання нової версії супутників.

title: An earthquake with a magnitude of 6.6 has been recorded northeast of the Loyalty
description:
An earthquake with a magnitude of 6.6 has been recorded northeast of the Loyalty Islands, which belong to New Caledonia — a French overseas territory in the south of the Pacific Ocean, the European‑Mediterranean Seismological Centre said.

According to it, the epicenter was located 252 km northeast of the city of Noumea. The focus was at a depth of 6 km. There is no information about casualties or damage. No tsunami threat was declared.
